profile.headline: Staff Full Stack Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Full-stack developer, programming since 1998.

Interested in physics, neuroscience, and chemistry.
(Broad spectrum interest in all fields related to science, technology, and philosophy)

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led a team of UI engineers in developing Intel's Tiber Secure Federated AI system UI, contributing 90% of the codebase during the PoC phase (ultimately to GA).  
• Coordinated with UX and product teams to deliver a full UI system, enhancing customer onboarding with initial features like SSO login and embedded JupyterLab.  
• Optimized Docker container build processes, achieving an 80% reduction in build time and streamlining the CI/CD pipeline for developers.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Collaborated with the Head of Product to decompose new features into manageable tasks, implementing them in Typescript (React + MobX).  
• Conducted A/B testing on features bi-weekly, contributing to a 50% increase in user conversion rates.
• Enhanced user experience by migrating the WYSIWYG editor to Tiptap, adding features like PDF uploads and version history.

positions.title: Blockchain Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
• Collaborated with product management and back-end teams to develop features for VMware Blockchain services using Angular and Docker.  
• Designed and deployed internal dev tools that enhanced engineering productivity, reducing attrition and increasing impact.  
• Integrated static code analysis tools into CI/CD pipelines, improving code quality and engineering velocity.  
• Expanded the DevOps team from 3 to 10 members, optimizing infrastructure management and CI/CD workflows.

positions.title: Head Blockchain Engineer
positions.description:
• Spearheaded the development of xDLT, the world's highest performing enterprise blockchain, achieving over 1 million TPS.  
• Designed and implemented a versatile platform for managing the full lifecycle of blockchain applications, enhancing client deployment efficiency.  
• Established XTTP standards for global data operations, ensuring compliance and security for end-user data management.

positions.title: Blockchain Dev. & Prototyping
positions.description:
• Spearheaded the development of a blockchain-based educational content marketplace, enhancing user engagement through tokenized incentives.  
• Led a team of 4 engineers to create a responsive mobile and desktop web application utilizing HTML5 technologies.  
• Designed and implemented an internal social network and search engine, improving content discoverability and user interaction.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed a comprehensive social networking platform and web-based LMS for college students.  
• Led a team to successfully launch a beta version, engaging around 4,000 users.  
• Utilized technologies such as NGINX, PHP, Node.JS, and MySQL on AWS to enhance performance.  
• Designed user-friendly UI/UX, incorporating real-time communication features using Websocket and WebRTC.

positions.title: Head Programmer
positions.description:
• Spearheaded the development of Joevis, a revolutionary web operating system enabling seamless multi-device functionality.  
• Engineered an extensive front-end JavaScript framework that enhanced user experience and application performance.  
• Implemented real-time communication tools using WebRTC, improving collaboration efficiency by 30%.  
• Designed a drag-and-drop application builder, empowering users to create custom applications without coding expertise.
